setup.text: The farmer stands by the field edge, a tray of threshed grain resting before him. He exhales a short, directed puff of air that lifts the chaff clear from the grain in one pass.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "Does it work on anything loose?"

The farmer puffs again, the air swirling over a patch of dry leaves. "Loose and light, mostly. Grain, leaves."

option_b.text: The player sweeps a pile of fallen leaves into the farmer's path. The puff of air catches the pile and scatters the leaves away in one gust.

option_c.text: The player directs the puff at a standing anvil nearby. The gust breaks around the heavy metal without moving it.
